description: Analytics Integration Layer contracts for Modulus: versioned dataset and field metadata with classification, a dataset catalog, a provider-neutral sink interface, and batch masking. Providers (ClickHouse, Parquet, messaging) ship as separate packages.

Apache Airflow trigger for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: when a backfill run completes, starts the Airflow DAG that transforms the warehouse tables (dbt models run inside it), through the Airflow stable REST API. Idempotent per run.

Apicurio Registry publisher for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: publishes each dataset version's JSON Schema as a versioned artifact (Apache-2.0 registry, Red Hat sponsored), so producers and consumers of the lake read the same contract.

ClickHouse sink for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: creates one tenant-keyed ReplacingMergeTree table per dataset version, verifies existing tables against the dataset contract, and writes masked batches with the official ClickHouse client, classifying failures as transient or permanent.

Debezium change reader for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: maps Debezium change events (inserts, updates, snapshot reads and deletes) of source tables to analytics records, so the warehouse follows hard deletes too. Works with the default JSON envelope and the flat payload form.

Apache Doris sink for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: loads each delivered batch through Stream Load as one labelled, idempotent load into a unique-key Doris table, so a resent batch is not loaded twice.

DuckDB reconciliation reader for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: counts a tenant's distinct records in the Parquet lake by reading the files in place, so the lake can be reconciled against the queue and the warehouse without a running warehouse (DuckDB, MIT).

Durable analytics delivery and backfill for Modulus on EF Core: per-tenant resumable backfill runs with checkpoints, an entity-backed source, a transactional queue of captured analytics records with duplicate-safe enqueue, atomic claiming across replicas, a retry schedule, dead-lettering and purge,…

Operational management API for Modulus analytics delivery: queue status, and list, inspect, replay and purge dead-lettered records, guarded by the critical analytics:manage permission. Responses never include record values.

Messaging sink for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: publishes every analytics record as an integration event on the module bus (RabbitMQ or Kafka), so a downstream consumer such as a stream processor or lakehouse loader can subscribe without querying Modulus.

OpenLineage emitter for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: reports each backfill run's start, completion and failure, with the source dataset and the warehouse tables it fills, as OpenLineage run events over HTTP (Marquez, DataHub, OpenMetadata and other OpenLineage backends).

OpenMetadata publisher for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: registers each dataset version as a table, with its columns, types, nullability and classification, in the OpenMetadata catalog (Apache-2.0, Linux Foundation AI and Data). Catalogs search and lineage for the warehouse.

Parquet sink for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: writes masked batches as immutable Parquet files through IFileStorage (local disk, S3, Azure Blob) in a Hive-style tenant and day layout that Spark, Trino, DuckDB and Iceberg can read, and publishes each dataset's JSON Schema next to the dat…

Apache Superset guest tokens for the Modulus Analytics Integration Layer: a token that lets an embedded dashboard show one company only, through a row-level-security rule on its tenant column, from the Superset REST API.

Test kit for Modulus analytics providers: an in-memory sink and a conformance suite that checks any IAnalyticsSink for idempotent dataset setup, duplicate-safe writes and tenant separation. Test-framework neutral.
Unofficial OpenUrzednik.NET adapter for Microsoft.Extensions.Logging: sends the clients' structured logs to ILogger.

Unofficial Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection registration for the OpenUrzednik.NET NBP clients: typed HttpClients, validated options, logging and tracing; ready for AddStandardResilienceHandler() on .NET 8 and later.
Unofficial OpenUrzednik.NET adapter for System.Diagnostics: turns the clients' spans into Activities for OpenTelemetry and other listeners.
Serve .NET models as erupt admin pages through an erupt cloud server.

Connectors for Modulus workflows: language model clients (Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible servers), email over SMTP and Slack webhooks, registered on a FlowRunner. Endpoints and credentials come from the app, never from a workflow.

Entity Framework Core store for Modulus localization: translations edited at runtime, kept in the application database. The application derives its own DbContext, so its migrations live in the application.

Tenant data lifecycle for Modulus: export (JSON, CSV, attachments, encrypted ZIP), offboarding (suspend, integrations, export, deletion, legal holds), retention, and signed deletion certificates. Each module declares and handles its own tenant data.
Entity Framework Core store for the Modulus tenant data lifecycle: operations, legal holds and pending deletions kept in the host database, outside every company's data.
